prompt:
Fix snippets/donation-round-up.liquid. It renders a cart prompt that offers to round the order total up to the next multiple of a step amount and donate the difference. Several inputs need correct default values. Inputs. All are top-level variables; none are under section.settings. Every variable is always supplied, but its value may be null. - cart_total_cents: integer or null. The cart total in cents. - round_to_cents: integer or null. The rounding step in cents. - charity_name: string or null. - currency_symbol: string or null. - button_label: string or null. Rules: 1. Step. Use round_to_cents when it is a positive integer. If it is null, 0 or negative, use 100. 2. Donation. If cart_total_cents is null, 0 or negative, output nothing at all. Otherwise compute remainder = cart_total_cents modulo step. - If the remainder is 0, output nothing. - Otherwise the donation is step minus remainder, in cents. 3. Charity. Strip leading and trailing whitespace from charity_name. If the result is null or empty, use the text: our partner charity 4. Button label. Strip leading and trailing whitespace from button_label. If the result is null or empty, use the text: Round up 5. Currency symbol. If currency_symbol is null or the empty string, use $. Otherwise use it exactly as given, without stripping. 6. Amount format. Format the donation as SYMBOL + whole units + '.' + cents, where: - whole units = donation integer-divided by 100, with no padding; - cents = donation modulo 100, always two digits (zero-padded, e.g. 0.05, 0.50, 9.70). 7. Escaping. HTML-escape the symbol, the charity name and the label. Output. Exactly one line with no whitespace between tags and no leading or trailing whitespace:

Round up your order and give AMOUNT to CHARITY.

In this template, DONATION is the donation as a plain integer number of cents. When nothing is output, the result is the empty string. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/donation-round-up.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
